title: Beating Harmful Stereotypes Through Facts: RAG-based Counter-speech Generation
benchmark_measurement: Generation of factual, RAG-based counter-speech in response to hate speech and harmful stereotypes targeting specific religious groups, namely Muslims and Jews.
findings: The proposed RAG-based framework effectively generates higher quality counter-speech against hate speech targeting religious groups compared to non-RAG models and competitive baselines. In pairwise comparisons against a GPT-4o baseline (Wilk et al., 2025), the system showed a 55.2% win rate for hate speech targeting Muslims and a 50% win rate for hate speech targeting Jews. Against another baseline (Russo, 2025), the system achieved a 95.7% win rate for the Jewish target group.
